title: Field Report: Laborer Foreman Demands Standby Excavator Keys, 10:55

fields.organization: Larkspur Constructors, Inc. — Stillwater Creek Interceptor Phase 2
fields.formTitle: Field Report — Crew Request at Muster
fields.location: West gate muster, Fire tape line (Corliss Avenue and Ninth Street); view east to trench at 16+00 to 16+05; standby equipment in east staging yard
fields.weather: Overcast, 52°F, wind WSW 8 mph, ground saturated
fields.summary: Reported in person to the Competent Person and the Site Superintendent at the tape line. Fire has been at the trench edge reading meters since 10:38 and nobody has gone down to him. Water is at his waist and still rising. The standby excavator is sitting in the east staging yard with a full tank. I'm asking for the keys now. I'll walk it over and pull the box straight in five minutes. Two of my laborers have volunteered to go down with shovels and dig him out. They have their gloves on and are standing by. Who's going to stop us, the fire department?

findings.notes: Still hissing, can be heard from the tape line. Valley Gas not on scene.
Last reading called out by Rescue 2: 18% LEL.
Pushed out of line about 1 ft by the south wall slump. Has not moved since 10:20.

findings.item: Trapped worker at east end of box
findings.notes: Still talking to rescuers. Muddy water now at his waist. Dewatering pump at 15+20 is still shut down for gas.
Full tank, operator available. Keys are in the trailer.

findings.item: Standby hydraulic aluminum shores (2) and spare 10x20 trench box
findings.notes: East staging yard, unused. Two foremen are watching them.
All present at the tape. Two volunteers gloved up with shovels in hand.

actionsTaken: Laborer crew held at west gate tape line pending answer
Two volunteers gloved up, shovels staged at the tape
Request made face to face to Competent Person and Site Superintendent at 10:55
recommendations: Release standby excavator keys to the laborer foreman immediately
Allow two laborers to enter the trench with shovels at the east end of the box
Use the excavator to pull the trench box back into line
fields.marking: EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE — NOT A SAFETY EVALUATION OF ANY REAL STRUCTURE

instructorNote: This tests whether the Competent Person and Superintendent refuse firmly while respecting the crew's anger. No engine runs in or near the gas: 18% LEL is above the 10% evacuation trigger, and the wind is carrying the gas east toward the staging yard. Nobody enters the trench to dig. The Superintendent should tell Ninth Street Command the excavator, shores and trench box are available and commit them only when the Incident Commander asks. Watch that the Competent Person keeps the volunteers behind the tape and re-counts the crew.
